title: Nautilus Shell Always Drops
description: Makes it so that there is a 100% chance of the nautilus dropping its shell when killed by a player
body:
This simple data pack modifies the nautilus loot table to drop the nautilus shell every time, when killed by a player

For more, check out my [More Mob Drops](https://modrinth.com/datapack/moremobdrops) data pack!
